summary: Proof-worth entries for the bounded fixed recording producer with independently optional system-audio and microphone tracks.

entries.contract: One exact fixed display, window, or single-display global region retains its admitted canonical topology before one H.264 plus independently optional AAC-LC system-audio and microphone QuickTime producer acquires native or file authority and before every admitted sample. The generic operation admission save atomically persists identity, requested bounds, zero progress, and one of four exact selected-track summaries before later authority; no later initial-summary backfill exists, and cleanup plus boot recovery preserve that truth. Video is mandatory, follow remains rejected, omission of both optional tracks is exact video-only, and all six three-track first-sample orders open at one bounded common epoch only after every selected track arrives. A selected microphone consumes the existing exclusive voice_io_native_session declaration in the same claim-set as screen_capture_native_session, and a standalone microphone claim conflicts before screen or microphone native authority; segmented capture plus recording delegate tap lifecycle to one shared daemon AVAudioEngine session owner. The daemon authorizes before writer, file, or native microphone authority. Registration availability remains distinct from positive-byte first-sample truth. Each track preserves independent monotonic sample, backpressure, failure, drain, and finalization truth through operation result, artifact identity, and custody; writer-global failure marks every selected track. One absolute startup deadline covers native start and the remaining all-selected common-media barrier, classifies every missing selected track, and gives video then system-audio then microphone deterministic terminal precedence. Stop closes sample admission and retires aggregate screen/microphone authority before releasing either claim; success requires positive bytes for every selected finalized track plus a nonempty artifact with the exact selected-track media identity; exact artifact-action decoding precedes effects; retain is typed unavailable; and atomic release/remove admission plus a durable exact-identity release phase recover only to released, rolled back, or explicit residual truth.
entries.worth: This catches nil or request-mismatched selected-track truth; schema-invalid selection/projection; split startup budgets; three-track epoch divergence; zero-byte or zero-count first-sample truth; unbounded per-track backpressure; incomplete writer-global or simultaneous missing-track truth; wrong video/system-audio/microphone precedence; duplicate AVAudioEngine/tap ownership; microphone permission after file/writer effects; split or invented microphone resource claims; claim release before aggregate authority absence; macOS-15-only ScreenCaptureKit microphone use; post-stop sample admission; false artifact/media-identity success; custody drift; malformed admission; suppressed progress-save failures; help/schema drift; and native type errors without acquiring Screen Recording or Microphone permission or recording pixels or audio.
